title: Travel: John Lennon – Toronto to Montreal | 1969
content:
John Lennon and Yoko Ono had flown from the Bahamas to Toronto on 25 May 1969. The following day they flew on to Montreal.

At 10am Lennon had an immigration hearing at Malton Airport. However, upon his arrival he discovered that it had been adjourned until 5 June. That allowed him and Ono to remain in Canada for 10 days.

They returned to the King Edward Sheraton in Toronto, where they spoke to members of the press corps. In the evening they returned to the airport, where they remained in a private room while Derek Taylor arranged their flights to Montreal.

They flew out of Toronto shortly before 10pm, and arrived at Montréal-Dorval International Airport an hour later. Lennon, Ono, and her daughter Kyoko were taken from the airport by police car, then switched to a taxi which took them to the Queen Elizabeth Hotel. They arrived at Suite 1742 at around midnight.
